question: How does Rudrāṇī participate in creation and worship according to Śrīkaṇṭha's will?
premises: By Śrīkaṇṭha's will, Rudrāṇī emits creation.
Rudrāṇī's body consists of the strands beginning with sattva.
In every subsidiary cycle, Rudrāṇī is worshiped on the altar.
inference: Rudrāṇī functions as both creative power and object of worship under Śrīkaṇṭha's will.
uncertainties: The ritual sense of vedī may be literal or symbolic.
plain_english: By his will, Rudrāṇī, whose body is made of the strands beginning with sattva, brings forth creation in each sub-cycle, and there Rudrāṇī is worshiped on the altar in every sub-cycle.
